description: MCP server for the Yandex Delivery B2B API: express claims, tracking, NDD/pickup-point orders.
name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-yandex-dostavka

environmentVariables.description: Shared Bearer token for both contours (dostavka.yandex.ru cabinet, «Интеграции» → «Получить токен»). Treat it as a secret.
environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DELIVERY_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Express-contour override of the shared token.
environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DELIVERY_EXPRESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Platform-contour override of the shared token.
environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DELIVERY_PLATFORM_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Platform API root; set https://b2b.taxi.tst.yandex.net for the test contour.
environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DELIVERY_PLATFORM_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Accept-Language header (required by the express methods).
environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DELIVERY_LANG

environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 always; 5xx/network for idempotent calls only).
environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_DELIVERY_MAX_RETRIES

title: Yandex Delivery MCP
